entities.name: Sebastian Vettel
entities.description: Vettel lives in Thurgovia, Switzerland, and has described himself as competitive, private and impatient. He married childhood friend Hanna Prater at a private ceremony in early 2019; they have three children. He is a fan of German football team Eintracht Frankfurt. He is a close friend of Kimi Räikkönen.

entities.name: Kimi Räikkönen
entities.description: Kimi Räikkönen, Vettel's teammate from 2015 to 2018, is a close friend.
